description: Expected metrics for the content fixtures. Counts are exact and were cross-checked with an independent regular-expression tokenizer. Flesch scores depend on the syllable heuristic, so they are ranges. The plain passage must stay inside grade 6 to 8.

dense_regulatory.txt.role: dense regulatory passage, two very long sentences

passive_heavy.txt.role: passive-heavy passage, six of eight sentences passive

undefined_acronyms.txt.role: acronyms: FCC and VPAT are defined, PDF and FAQ are allowlisted, five are not
